item.title: Start with usage that does not expire
item.summary: Eligible new members receive a Starter usage balance that remains available until it is used, with remaining usage and paid plan choices visible in Settings.
item.details: Eligible legacy trial value carries into Starter. When the balance is exhausted, Murph pauses AI work without deleting account state and Settings offers eligible paid plans; usage top-ups remain available only to active paid-plan owners.
